#!/bin/bash
owner=mesut146
repo=lang

# Get workflow IDs with status "active"
workflow_ids=($(gh api repos/$owner/$repo/actions/workflows --paginate | jq '.workflows[] | select(.["state"] | contains("active")) | .id'))


for workflow_id in "${workflow_ids[@]}"
do
  echo "Listing runs for the workflow ID $workflow_id"
  runs=$(gh api repos/$owner/$repo/actions/workflows/$workflow_id/runs --paginate)
  echo $runs>act.txt
  run_ids=($(echo $runs | jq '.workflow_runs[] | .id'))
  run_numbers=($(echo $runs | jq '.workflow_runs[] | .run_number'))
  titles=($(echo $runs | jq '.workflow_runs[] | .display_title'))
  
  idx=0
  #leave last 3 runs only, delete rest
  for run_id in "${run_ids[@]}"
  do
    run_number=${run_numbers[$idx]}
    title=${titles[$idx]}
    if [ "$idx" -lt 3 ]; then
      idx=$((idx+1))
      continue
    fi
    echo "Deleting Run ID $run_id run_number=$run_number title=$title"
    gh api repos/$owner/$repo/actions/runs/$run_id -X DELETE >/dev/null
    idx=$((idx+1))
  done
done

include "Lexer.g";

unit: importStmt* item*;

importStmt: "import" name ("/" name)*;

name: IDENT;

item: global | decl | methodDecl | implDecl | traitDecl | externBlock | constDecl | typeAlias;

global: "static" name (":" type)? "=" expr;

decl: structDecl | enumDecl;
structDecl: "struct" type "{" field* "}";
field: name ":" type;
enumDecl: "enum" type "{" enumVariant ("," enumVariant)* "}";
enumVariant: name "(" field ("," field)* ")";

type: prim_type | arrayType | sliceType | refType;
prim_type: "i8" | "i16" | "i32" | "i64" | "u8" | "u16" | "u32" | "u64";
arrayType: "[" type ";" INTEGER_LIT "]";
sliceType: "[" type "]";
refType: name generics? ("::" name generics?)*;
generics: "<" type ("," type)* ">";


methodDecl:
  "func" name generics? "(" (name ","?)? params* ")" (":" type)? block;

params: param ("," param)*;

param:
  name ":" type ("?" | "=" expr)?;

//statements-------------------------------------------
block:
  "{" stmt* expr? "}";

stmt:
  whileStmt | forStmt | forEachStmt | exprStmt | varDecl | returnStmt | continueStmt | breakStmt;

exprStmt:
  expr ";";

whileStmt:
  "while" "(" expr ")" stmt;

forStmt:
  "for" "(" varDecl? ";" expr? ";" exprs? ")" stmt;
exprs:
  expr ("," expr)*;  
  
forEachStmt:
  "for" "(" "let" name ":" expr ")" stmt;  

//expressions-----------------------------------------------
varDecl:
  "let" varDeclFrag ("," varDeclFrag)*;

varDeclFrag:
  name ("=" expr | "?")?;
  


tuple_or_paren: "(" expr ")" #paren
  | "(" ")" #unit
  | "(" expr "," ")" #single
  | "(" expr ("," expr)+ ","? ")" #multi
;

lambda: "|" lambda_args? "|" (":" type)? (stmt | expr);
lambda_args: name (":" type)? ("," name (":" type)?)*;

prim: 
    literal
  | lambda
  | "func" "(" (type ("," type)*)? ")"
  | match_expr | if_expr | iflet_expr | block_expr
  | tuple_or_paren
  | "[" expr* "]" #array
  | ("+" | "-" | "++" | "--" | "!" | "*" | "&") expr #unary
  | methodCall | macroCall | type | name
;

prim_name: type (callTail | "!" callTail)?;

methodCall: expr "." name generics? callTail;
callTail: "(" args? ")";
args: expr ("," expr)*;

macroCall: type "." name callTail;

prim2: res=prim res=obj(res) ("." INTEGER_LIT | "." IDENT | "." IDENT callTail | "[" expr (".." expr)? "]" | "?")*;

expr:
| prim2 "as" type | prim2 "is" prim2
| expr ("*" | "/" | "%") expr %left
| expr ("+" | "-") expr %left
| expr ("<<" | ">" ">" | ">" ">" ">") expr %left
| expr ("<" | ">" | "<=" | ">=") expr %left

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

      - name: "set env"
        run: |
          echo "toolchain_dir=x-toolchain-${last_version}-$(uname -m)" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "toolchain_arm64_dir=x-toolchain-${last_version}-aarch64" >> $GITHUB_ENV

          echo "tool3_x86_64_zip=x-toolchain-${new_version}-stage2-x86_64.zip" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: "download toolchain"
        run: |
          gh auth status
          gh release download v${last_version}&&echo "download toolchain '$toolchain_dir'"
          unzip $toolchain_dir.zip
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: build-x86_64
        id: build_x86_64
        run: |
          XOPT="" XSTAGE="1" bin/build.sh $toolchain_dir $new_version

      - name: Upload Artifacts x86_64
        if: ${{ steps.build_x86_64.outcome == 'success' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ${{ env.tool2_x86_64_zip }}
          path: ${{ env.tool2_x86_64_zip }}
          compression-level: 0

      - name: build-arm64
        id: build_arm64
        run: |
          unzip $toolchain_arm64_dir.zip
          XOPT="" XSTAGE="1" ./bin/docker.sh $toolchain_dir $toolchain_arm64_dir $new_version

      - name: Upload Artifacts arm64
        if: ${{ steps.build_arm64.outcome == 'success' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ${{ env.tool2_arm64_zip }}
          path: ${{ env.tool2_arm64_zip }}
          compression-level: 0

      - name: Create Release
        if: ${{ env.publish == 'true' && env.new_version != env.last_version }}
        id: create_release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        with:
          tag_name: v${{ env.new_version }}
          release_name: v${{ env.new_version }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  fi

Fixed cross-compile to Termux ARM64 + CI for all toolchains.

What was broken:
- `bin/make_toolchain.sh:61`: `[ ! -z "XTERMUX" ]` always true, rpath wrong. Fixed to `"$XTERMUX"`.
- Name collision: Termux and gnu both produced `x-toolchain-*-aarch64.zip`. Now Termux uses `termux-aarch64` (`bin/termux.sh`, `make_toolchain.sh`).
- `bin/termux.sh`: `mkdir out; rm -rf build` deleted its own out dir, hardcoded `LIBLLVM=.../libLLVM.so.19`, relative NDK path, unconditional `$LIBZ3`. Fixed ordering, glob `libLLVM.so*` from `target_tool`, absolute `NDK_ROOT` check, `LIBZ3` optional, `target_triple=aarch64-linux-android24`.
- `bin/llvm.sh`: was downloading Debian arm64 LLVM for Termux (unusable). Now early-exit when `XTERMUX`, libLLVM comes from prior Termux toolchain.
- `bin/apt_cross.sh`: re-downloaded NDK every run. Now guarded.
- `bin/docker_termux.sh`: ignored `$3`, hardcoded zip name `*-aarch64.zip`. Now respects `$3`, outputs `*-termux-aarch64.zip`, conditional bootstrap download. Fixed `sync.sh` typos `termuz_tool/tmux`.
- `.github/workflows/main.yml`: only built x86_64 + gnu-arm64. Added `build-termux` -> `./bin/docker_termux.sh` + artifact `x-toolchain-<ver>-termux-aarch64.zip`.

Run locally (you have x86_64 toolchain):
```
unzip x-toolchain-1.00-x86_64.zip
unzip x-toolchain-1.00-termux-aarch64.zip
./bin/docker_termux.sh x-toolchain-1.00-x86_64 1.01 x-toolchain-1.00-termux-aarch64
```

On Termux device:
```
unzip x-toolchain-1.01-termux-aarch64.zip
export LD=clang++ TERMUX=1
x-toolchain-1.01-termux-aarch64/bin/x c -out out -stdpath x-toolchain-1.01-termux-aarch64/src tests/normal/01-var.x
```

Note: first-ever Termux bootstrap still needs a published `x-toolchain-1.00-termux-aarch64.zip` for its Android `libLLVM.so`; otherwise NDK sysroot LLVM must be staged manually.

    popd
  fi
  exit 0
fi

# Android linking (libLLVM comes from the previous Termux toolchain instead),
# but we still need llvm-19-dev headers to compile cpp_bridge with the NDK.

if [ ! -z "$XTERMUX" ]; then

    if ! grep -Rq "apt.llvm.org/noble" /etc/apt/sources.list /etc/apt/sources.list.d/; then
      sudo mkdir -p /etc/apt/keyrings
      wget -qO /etc/apt/keyrings/llvm.asc https://apt.llvm.org/llvm-snapshot.gpg.key
      echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/llvm.asc] http://apt.llvm.org/noble/ llvm-toolchain-noble main" | \
      sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/llvm.list

    mkdir -p $XTMP
    pushd $XTMP
    sudo apt-get update
    sudo apt-get download llvm-19-dev
    dpkg-deb -x ./llvm-19-dev*.deb .
    popd
  fi
  exit 0
fi

On the `libxml2.so.2` problem: that's SONAME drift. Our `libLLVM.so.19` was linked in June against `libxml2.so.2`, and Termux has since moved to `libxml2.so.16`. The loader matches `DT_NEEDED` names exactly, so it fails even though a compatible library exists.

```
ls $PREFIX/lib/ | grep -iE 'xml2|libffi|libz|zstd|c\+\+'

readelf -d x-toolchain-1.01-termux-aarch64/lib/libLLVM.so.19 | grep NEEDED

```

Likely quick fix if ABIs are compatible (LLVM barely uses libxml2):

```
ln -s $PREFIX/lib/libxml2.so.16 $PREFIX/lib/libxml2.so.2
```

If more entries drifted (e.g. `libffi.so`, `libzstd.so.1`), same symlink trick applies per library — the diagnostics will show which. The durable fix is bundling those compat symlinks inside the toolchain's `lib/` (its rpath checks `$ORIGIN/../lib` first), which I'll add to `make_toolchain.sh` once we see the full list.

Fix verified on my side — `patchelf` rewrites both the dependency name and its version records cleanly. And this explains the symlink failure: Android's loader keys libraries by their internal SONAME, so a file named `libxml2.so.2` whose real SONAME is `libxml2.so.16` can never satisfy the request. No symlink will work; the binary itself must ask for the new name.

x-toolchain-1.01-termux-aarch64/bin/x -v

Root cause found and fixed — this one was deep:

- Our compiler builds its LLVM `TargetMachine` through the raw C++ API, which defaults `TargetOptions::UseInitArray` to **false**, so LLVM emitted legacy **`.ctors`** sections. `glibc` still honors `.ctors`, which is why x86_64 never noticed — but Android's linker only runs **`.init_array`**, so every global constructor silently never ran on Termux.
- Fix: `opt.UseInitArray = true` in `createTargetMachine` (`cpp_bridge/src/bridge.cpp`, home repo). Verified with an isolated LLVM API test: `.ctors` → `.init_array` for `aarch64-linux-android24`.
- Rebuilding as `1.02` from scratch in `/root/lang` (old objects wiped so nothing stale survives). Will verify `.init_array` is populated in the new binary, then persist the zip to home.

Note: this also changes future x86_64/gnu builds to `.init_array` — same as clang/gcc, strictly more standard.

content.text: Analyzing PIE relocation behavior and storage constraints while outlining toolchain setup steps.

False alarm — and good news: **1.03 is correct**. Those zeros are normal: it's a PIE binary, so `.init_array` slots are zero on disk and filled by the loader via 8 `R_AARCH64_RELATIVE` relocs, all pointing at real `static_init` functions. I verified each relocation target. The earlier "buckets len=0" failure was 1.01 (real `.ctors`, genuinely ignored by Android).

On device with 1.03:

```
cd ~/lang
unzip -o x-toolchain-1.03-termux-aarch64.zip
patchelf --replace-needed libxml2.so.2 libxml2.so.16 x-toolchain-1.03-termux-aarch64/lib/libLLVM.so.19
./x-toolchain-1.03-termux-aarch64/bin/x -v
./bin/test.sh ./x-toolchain-1.03-termux-aarch64
```

(The `libxml2` patch is still needed — that ships inside `libLLVM.so.19`, unchanged by this rebuild.)

Also: home is at 100% (19M free) after the zip copy. You'll want to delete the older `x-toolchain-1.0[12]-termux-aarch64.zip` files once 1.03 checks out — they're superseded.
